plugins.name: camera-hw-accel
plugins.title: Camera HW Accel
plugins.description:
Tap into the SoC's video pipeline instead of CPU-encoding every frame. MJPEG over HTTP at /webcam, WebRTC at /webrtc; works on any browser, smooth 30fps even with two cameras attached.

To have these auto-registered as cameras in Fluidd and Mainsail (so you don't have to add them by hand under Settings → Cameras), also install b3d://bespok3d-org/webcam-builtin for the built-in MIPI camera and b3d://bespok3d-org/webcam-usb for the external USB camera.
plugins.tagline: HW-accelerated MJPEG and WebRTC streaming for MIPI & USB cameras.

plugins.name: fluidd
plugins.title: Fluidd
plugins.description: Swaps SM's outdated Fluidd for the current upstream release. You get input-shaper graphs, integrated config/G-code editors, tool-colour preview, modern mesh viz. Uninstall reverts to the SM-shipped copy automatically via overlayfs; no nginx config touched.
plugins.tagline: Modern Fluidd v1.37.0: replaces the stock SM build.

config.label: Fluidd port
config.hint: Auto-assigned. Make Fluidd primary to serve it on port 80.

plugins.name: mainsail
plugins.title: Mainsail
plugins.description: Installs Mainsail v2.17.0 as a second web frontend. Runs on port 81 by default so Fluidd stays on port 80. Set port 80 to make Mainsail primary; Fluidd shifts to 81 automatically.
plugins.tagline: Mainsail web interface alongside Fluidd, on your chosen port.

config.label: Mainsail port
config.hint: Auto-assigned. Make Mainsail primary to serve it on port 80.

plugins.name: moonraker-auth
plugins.title: Moonraker Login
plugins.description: Controls Moonraker's force_logins setting. When on, the web UI requires a login before any control; when off, local clients connect without logging in. Toggle the setting below before installing.
plugins.tagline: Require a login for the web UI, or allow open access.

config.label: Require login
config.hint: On: the web UI asks for a login before any control. Off: local clients connect without logging in.

plugins.name: remote-screen
plugins.title: Remote Screen
plugins.description:
Mirror the printer's on-device touchscreen to a browser. Low-overhead framebuffer capture, no UI changes on the device side.

To have the screen appear as a tile in Fluidd and Mainsail (alongside your cameras, no manual setup under Settings → Cameras), also install b3d://bespok3d-org/webcam-screen; registers the mirror as a Moonraker [webcam] iframe entry sized for the U1's 480:320 display.
plugins.tagline: Stream your printer's framebuffer as MJPEG.

plugins.name: rfid-ntag
plugins.title: RFID Spool Reader
plugins.description: USB RFID reader picks up OpenSpool-encoded NTAG215 cards. Writes the current spool's metadata to rfid_data.json on every card event so the rest of the stack just knows.
plugins.tagline: NTAG215/OpenSpool RFID: your filament knows what it is.
